answer: Faking thousands of identities becomes costly because every bond is real capital at risk, slashed on failed audits. Sybil resistance can work through a staked reputation slot registry: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed influence, and peers audit randomly assigned tasks. Think of it as a summit of verified climbers, each roped to collateral, while the lagoon of anonymous wallets stays shallow and the garden of trusted participants grows only where stakes are planted. Attackers pay full bond per fake identity. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
